title: Origami EPUB Profile 1.0 — the interaction record
description:
Schema for the record declared with properties="origami:interaction". Authoritative for table formulas, authored layouts, interaction declarations and the 3D model index. See profile §9.

Two things this schema exists to prevent. First, §9.0's separation: the semantic members are declared forbidden below, so a record carrying them is rejected by the schema itself rather than by a validator's own walk — deletion, not renaming, because a renamed member is a second copy waiting to diverge. Second, §14's boundary: this record holds what the WRITER authored, never reader state. Reading position, chosen view, personal layouts and highlights belong in external W3C Web Annotation documents, and the known reader-state member names are forbidden here too.

document.description: A small identity block, permitted in both records so each is identifiable alone (§1.13, §11). The package governs (§11.3).

authors.description: Strings, or {name} / {family, given} objects — both are read.

tables.description: Live tables (§9.2). The XHTML table is authoritative for presented values; this record is authoritative for formulas.

cells.description: Row-major. A cell's value is the computed value as published; a reader that cannot evaluate a formula falls back to it.

map.description: Authored layouts (§9.3). Coordinates are writer-defined and unitless; a reader MUST NOT read them as metres, and MUST NOT write reader-created positions here (§1.11, §14).

nodes.description: Optional node labels for the authored map.

models.description: Convenience index of 3D figures (§9.5). The [data-model-src] carrier in the content document governs (§11.3, §6.9).

up.description: Exactly Y or Z. A reader trusts this rather than applying its own default (§6.9.4).

extent.description: Real-world bounding size in metres, three numbers. MUST appear together with units: assuming metres for a model that never stated them can build a hundredfold object (§6.9.4).

stretchtext.description: Optional index of contracted passages (§9.4). The body is authoritative (§6.10).

concepts.description: FORBIDDEN. Belongs to the semantic record as `concepts` (§8.3, §9.0).

glossary.description: FORBIDDEN. This is the semantic record's `concepts` under another name — the exact duplication §9.0 exists to end. Delete it; do not rename it.

citations.description: FORBIDDEN. Belongs to the semantic record as `citations` (§8.4, §9.0).

references.description: FORBIDDEN. This is the semantic record's `citations` under another name, and the bibliographic data itself belongs in references.bib (§10, §9.0).

headings.description: FORBIDDEN. Belongs to the semantic record as `structure.headings` (§8.2, §9.0).

structure.description: FORBIDDEN. Belongs to the semantic record (§8.2, §9.0).

endnotes.description: FORBIDDEN. Belongs to the semantic record as `endnotes` (§8.7, §9.0).

footnotes.description: FORBIDDEN. Belongs to the semantic record as `endnotes` (§8.7, §9.0).

links.description: FORBIDDEN. Cross-document relationships belong to the semantic record as `links` (§8.5, §9.0).

lineage.description: FORBIDDEN. Belongs to the semantic record as `lineage` (§8.6, §9.0).

equations.description: FORBIDDEN. MathML in the body is authoritative; the index belongs to the semantic record (§6.7, §9.0).

readingPosition.description: FORBIDDEN. Reader state never enters a publication (§1.11, §14).

readerState.description: FORBIDDEN. Reader state never enters a publication (§1.11, §14).

runtimeState.description: FORBIDDEN. Reader state never enters a publication (§1.11, §14). This record holds what the writer authored, not what a reader did.

annotations.description: FORBIDDEN. Personal annotations belong in external W3C Web Annotation documents (§14).

modelMediaType.description: §6.9.3. model/vnd.usdz+zip is not IANA-registered; match it exactly.

formula.description: §9.2. A leading =, A1-style references within this table only, the operators + - * / ^, parentheses, and documented functions. A formula MUST NOT reference another table, another document, or any external resource — so no ! sheet qualifier and no [ ] external reference.
